# git: alias: refactor contribute command

Simplify `git contribute` ([[DOT-319]]) now that [octomation/maintainer#57](https://github.com/octomation/maintainer/issues/57) lets `suggest` derive its reference date itself: the alias no longer needs to compute and pass the last commit's date, only to take the suggestion and commit.
